function ShowSearchResults() { $('#CandidateFirstName').val($('#CandidateFirstName').val().trim()); $('#CandidateLastName').val($('#CandidateLastName').val().trim()); let searchParams = new FormData(document.getElementById('searchForm')); iForms.ShowSearchMessage(true); $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "/Candidate/CandidateSearch/", data: searchParams, contentType: false, processData: false, }).done(function (data) { $('#gridContainer').html(data); $("#gridCandidateSearch").dataTable(); $('#gridContainer').show(); iForms.HideMessage(); $('.is-reveal-open').css("position", "static"); $('.is-reveal-open').css("overflow-y", "auto"); SetSessionData(); }).fail(function (error) { iForms.HideMessage(); iForms.Alert('Error searching for Candidates'); }); } function IsControlPopulated(selector) { // If input text box and not blank, set session storage if ($(selector).is("input")){ if ($(selector).val() != "") return true; return false; } // If select box and not default value, set session storage if ($(selector).is("select")) { if ($(selector).val() != "All" && $(selector).val() != null) { return true; } } // If candidate table if ($(selector).is("table")) { if ($(selector + ' tr').length > 0) { return true; } } // if multi select if ($('.multi-select span')) { if ($('.multi-select span').val() != "Select options") { return true; } } // otherwise default to false return false; } function SetSessionData() { var countyKeys = []; // Store list of selected options from the Election/County multi select control $('#countyList').find('.selected').each(function () { countyKeys.push($(this).find("input").attr("title")); }) sessionStorageKeys.forEach(key => { var selector = '#' + key; if (typeof (IsControlPopulated(selector)) != "undefined") { switch (key) { case "gridCandidateSearch": // For Table we only want to store indicator. We'll search again if grid was previously populated sessionStorage.setItem(key, "true"); break; case "countyList": // Push selected option array set above sessionStorage.setItem("countyList", countyKeys); break; default: sessionStorage.setItem(key, $(selector).val()); break; } } }); } function LoadFromSessionData() { sessionStorageKeys.forEach(key => { var selector = '#' + key; if (typeof (sessionStorage.getItem(key)) != "undefined" && sessionStorage.getItem(key) != null) { switch (key) { case "gridCandidateSearch": // nothing to load, will trigger search below break; case "countyList": // manually trigger option click event for any of the multi select options previously selected. setMultiSelectOptions(key); break; default: $(selector).val(sessionStorage.getItem(key)); break; } } }); if (sessionStorage.getItem("gridCandidateSearch") != "undefined" && sessionStorage.getItem("gridCandidateSearch") != null) { ShowSearchResults(); } } function setMultiSelectOptions(sessionKey) { // Build array to iterate through and trigger click events var optionArray = sessionStorage.getItem(sessionKey).split(","); // If items are found, trigger the corresponding checkbox by using "tile" selector. if (optionArray.length > 0); { optionArray.forEach(function (option) { $('#' + sessionKey + ` input[type=checkbox][title="${option}"]`).click(); }); } } function RemoveSessionStorage() { sessionStorageKeys.forEach(key => { sessionStorage.removeItem(key); }); } $(document).ready(function () { $('#reset').on("click", function () { // part of multi-select library that resets all classes as needed. $('select[multiple]').multiselect('reset'); $('#gridContainer').hide(); RemoveSessionStorage(); }); $("#SelectedAssociatedCounties").multiselect({ search: true, selectAll: true, columns: 1, checkboxAutoFit: true }); $('#back').on("click", function () { RemoveSessionStorage(); }); $('#search').on("click", function () { ShowSearchResults(); }); LoadFromSessionData(); }); $(window).on('pageshow', function () { iForms.HideMessage(); })
